chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Abdullah b. al-Hasan al-Mu'addab narrated to us from Ahmad b. Ali al-Isfahani. He said: Muhammad b. Abi Umar al-Nahdi informed me. He said: My father narrated to me from Muhammad b. Marwan from Muhammad b. al-Sa'ib from Abu Salih from Ibn Abbas.
Regarding the saying of the Mighty and Majestic: "Peace be upon the Family of Yasin" [37:130], he said: Upon the family of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family.

key_terms.آل محمد: The Family of Muhammad - referring to Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.إل ياسين: The Family of Yasin - interpreted as the Family of Muhammad

ai.seo_question: What did Ibn Abbas say about "Peace be upon the Family of Yasin" in Quran 37:130?
ai.summary: This hadith provides another chain of transmission for the interpretation of Quran 37:130, where Ibn Abbas identifies "the Family of Yasin" as the family of Prophet Muhammad (s). This narration through al-Kalbi and Abu Salih represents one of the most widely cited tafsir chains for this verse, emphasizing that the divine greeting of peace is directed at the Prophet's household (Ahl al-Bayt).
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
